resources.string: Bypasses eSIM requirements for certain apps and can be used to retrieve eSIM codes.(I.e. LPA link)
LSPosed is not activated, or your environment is not supported. Please check your framework status.
Spoof eSIM support to retrieve eSIM codes.\nSelect the apps you want to spoof.\n(If the app is already running, manually kill it for changes to take effect.)
Note: Spoofing software only and some applications may not work.

Fixes access issues on devices where eUICC [ISD-R] has exclusive access.
Requires selecting [com.android.phone] and rebooting.
Note: Hot-swapping is not supported. Insert the eUICC card before rebooting.
Alternatively, manually kill the process to re-trigger the hook, This option supports hot-reload while hooked.

Bypass ARA/ARF restrictions. Typically used for OMAPI access on cards without ARA.
Requires selecting [com.android.se] and rebooting.
Alternatively, manually kill the process to re-trigger the hook, This option supports hot-reload while hooked.
Note: Do not enable unless specifically required. This reduces security.

Comma-separated package names. Only these apps will bypass ARA/ARF.
Leave empty to bypass for all apps.
Note: This option supports package name whitelist hot-reload while hooked.
e.g. com.google.android.euicc,im.angry.easyeuicc
